title: Status line: stop false and repeated offers (help text only, a failed folder swap on Windows, a record reset by an old orion)
summary: Computers were asked to take a new status line when a release had changed only its help text, a failed folder swap on Windows made untouched copies read as edited, and an orion from before three-part versions brought the same question back in a loop. Help text alone is no longer offered, a busy folder is replaced in place with a nested leftover no longer counted as an edit, and a per-computer note in the cache folder keeps what was taken or skipped; 12 new suite checks.
